bifrost: springboard/src/media/capture.rs (microphone WAV recorder), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (recording owner), springboard/src/svc.rs (record_start), springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs (still frames)
summary: ReplayKit records screen video, app audio and microphone, and feeds live broadcasts. BifrOSt has no screen video recording and no SDK API for it; the only capture is a system microphone recorder used by Voice Memos, which apps cannot call through the SDK. Screenshots are still frames only.

features.note: no video capture path in the shell, the SDK or the MCP tools; the REA render of the landing page marks RPScreenRecorder as Deprecated, but the DocC JSON for that symbol does not show the flag, so the deprecation is unconfirmed
no rolling buffer of screen or audio
system ALSA microphone recording to WAV exists; it is used by the Voice Memos app and has no app-facing SDK API and no screen track to mux with
audiod plays and records the microphone only; no loopback of app output
the camera module serves the Camera app, not a recording overlay; no preview view is exposed to apps
no recorder object or availability callback

features.feature: Preview and edit UI for a recording
features.note: no clip preview or trim sheet in the shell or SDK
no broadcast extension point and no streaming of app frames
the share picker covers sharing items, not choosing a broadcast service
errors belong to the ReplayKit and ScreenCaptureKit pipeline, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No screen video recording for apps, the shell or the MCP tools (only still screenshots in springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs).
No SDK API for recording: no RPScreenRecorder equivalent in springboard/sdk/src/.
Microphone recording (springboard/src/media/capture.rs) is not reachable from app SDK code; it is used by Voice Memos only.
No app or system audio capture; audiod does not loop back output.
No clip buffer, clip export, preview or trim UI.
No live broadcast extension point or broadcast picker.
